title: ARS-to-KG Structured Handoff
description: Per-article structured handoff from ARS HITL outputs to the KG layer. One file per article/run.

article_id.description: Unique identifier for the article. Used in per-article output filenames. Defaults to the source_document stem if absent.

schema_version.description: Schema version for this handoff payload.

contract_version.description: Versioned KG contract expected by downstream embedding and LLM systems.

run_id.description: ARS run identifier for traceability across pipeline runs.

source_document.description: Source document path or artifact identifier (e.g. relative path to article.md).

items.description: Structured KG candidate items approved or reviewed during the ARS HITL loop.

retrieval_policy.description: Preferred retrieval policy for downstream constraint consumers.

KGCandidate.description: A single structured KG candidate from the ARS HITL review loop.

id.description: Unique identifier for this KG object (e.g. 'claim:article-123:1').

source_document.description: Source document path or artifact identifier.

source_section.description: Section heading or label within the source document.

supporting_quote_or_span.description: Exact quote or span from the source document that supports this item.

extraction_method.description: Method used to extract this item (e.g. 'ars_hitl', 'markdown_heuristic').

reviewer.description: Identity of the reviewer who approved or updated this item.

reviewed_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of the review decision.

article_id.description: Article identifier (propagated from the parent handoff object if not set here).

run_id.description: ARS run identifier (propagated from the parent handoff object if not set here).

related_evidence_ids.description: Optional Evidence object ids linked to this item.

related_concept_ids.description: Optional Concept object ids linked to this item.

source_citation.description: Citation string for the source used to support this item.

canonical_label.description: Preferred human-readable label, especially for Concept items.

aliases.description: Alternative labels or synonyms for this item.

iri.description: Optional explicit stable IRI to use in semantic web exports.

source_span_start.description: Inclusive source span start character offset.

source_span_end.description: Exclusive source span end character offset.

canonical_id.description: Stable canonical ID for normalized concepts/entities.

relation_edges.description: Typed relation edges with optional confidence.
